To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the effects of climate on agricultural production are not only positive but also negative and the social customs of female labour participation in the Mediterranean region slightly restrain agricultural production in the region.
the effects of climate changes in the Mediterranean region of Turkey are positive under the sub scenario of no CO2 effect and are negative under the sub scenario with doubling CO2 effect.

the effects of climate changes on farm households are not only determined by the climate changes themselves but also by the social customs that restrict female labour participation in agricultural production.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of social customs and climate change on farm households in the Mediterranean region of Turkey.
the impacts of social customs and climate change on agricultural production in rural communities in the Mediterranean region of Turkey.
the impacts of climate change on the agricultural sector in rural areas of Turkey.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the social customs of female labour participation have an important effect on the reaction of farm households to climate change.

the social customs of female labour participation in the Mediterranean Turkey are not a serious constraint on agricultural production, but they may be one of the reasons for the lower agricultural production in this region.
social customs have a minor impact on the farm production in rural areas, while climate change has a major impact on farm production.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
climate change will have a serious impact on agricultural production in the Mediterranean region of Turkey.
climate change will have a negative effect on agricultural production, but the negative effect will be reduced by the CO2 fertilization effect.
social customs are not a significant obstacle to climate change adaptation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the social customs that restrict female labour participation in the farm production are a significant barrier to increasing farm income in rural areas of Mediterranean Turkey.
the farm profit is sensitive to climate change and social customs that restrict female labour participation in the Mediterranean Turkey.
social customs can be considered as a constraint to increase agricultural production in the face of climate change.
